surface: The handsontable editor, a grid of choices under a text field: opening it, arrowing down its rows, and Enter committing the highlighted row.

steps.note: Enter opens the editor on the cell holding `Al`: a text field over a one-column grid of Alpha, Alfa and Alto. The editor moves through that grid with ArrowUp and ArrowDown only; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move the caret in the text field, so no key crosses the inner grid's columns. Required: the text and the field's role (NVDA `edit`, VoiceOver with Chromium `text entry area`). VoiceOver with WebKit names no role for an editor (grid-core).

ArrowDown highlights the inner grid's first row while the focus stays in the text field. Finding: nothing is said on any reader, on this step or the next two: the editor sets no aria-activedescendant and the inner grid is built with ariaTags off, so the highlighted row is never exposed.
Enter commits the highlighted row and moves the selection one row down (enterMoves); the focus reaches the next row's cell, `Al`, and every reader reads it. VoiceOver names no row (its behavior).
ArrowUp moves to the edited cell, which now holds the committed row's value, `Alto`.
